image_depth_review.scope: Every scored frame; identical actual-mesh silhouette metric for control and candidate. Image alignment is a proxy, not official CD-O.

grasp_proximity.scope: Unsigned nearest mesh-vertex proxy on local FPS512 points; checks only control-contact-like frames. This is not a grasp label or a penetration calculation.

hand_review.scope: Released generalized-winding containment and triangle distance; full predicted hands plus local FPS512 subset. Exact host hand-role IDs and positive GT alignment scale are unavailable. This is not an official PEN score.
